engineOverview.title: Range Rover Evoque 204DTD Engine: Your Complete Owner's Guide
paragraphs: The Range Rover Evoque 204DTD engine is a 2.0-litre Ingenium four-cylinder diesel from Jaguar Land Rover, fitted to many lower-output Evoque diesel versions. Its blend of economy and everyday performance makes it popular, but high mileage, short journeys and missed services can lead to timing chain, turbo or internal failures.

Several Ingenium diesels look almost identical, yet differ in calibration, turbocharger, emissions hardware and ancillaries. That is why we identify every 204DTD engine using your VIN, the engine code on the block and your registration, rather than relying on the model name alone.

If your Evoque Ingenium engine has failed or is showing warning signs, our team will inspect it, explain the realistic options and price each one. Call us or send your registration details to request a quote.

engineProblems.title: Common Range Rover Evoque 204DTD Faults
engineProblems.description: Acting on the first signs of trouble often keeps a repair affordable and protects the rest of the engine.

cards.title: Timing Chain Wear and Noise
cards.description: A rattle at start-up, rough running or timing-related fault codes can mean the chain has stretched or the guides and tensioner have worn. We measure chain wear and check valve timing.

cards.title: Oil Level Rising Between Services
cards.description: Diesel can enter the sump when DPF regenerations are repeatedly interrupted, thinning the oil and reducing protection for the bearings and timing chain. We test the oil and review regeneration data.

cards.title: DPF Regeneration Problems
cards.description: Mostly short-journey driving can stop the particulate filter clearing properly, triggering warning lights, reduced power and more frequent regeneration attempts. We read live data and assess filter loading.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Turbo Whine or Power Loss
cards.description: A whining noise, slow acceleration, limp mode or oily intake pipes may point to turbocharger wear, a split hose or an oil supply issue. We check boost, pipework and turbo condition.

cards.title: Injector Faults and Rough Idle
cards.description: Misfiring, rough idle, heavy smoke or hard starting can be caused by a faulty injector or a leaking injector seal on the cylinder head. We run injector checks and inspect the seals.

cards.title: Bearing Knock or Oil Pressure Warning
cards.description: A low oil pressure light, deep knocking or metal particles in the oil suggest bearing or oil supply problems that need urgent attention. We advise whether a rebuild or replacement is appropriate.

cards.title: Matching the Right 204DTD Engine
cards.description: Ingenium engines can share a block design yet differ in calibration and ancillaries. We compare your VIN and engine code with the replacement unit, and confirm the gearbox type and front- or all-wheel-drive layout before any 2.0 Ingenium engine is supplied.

faq.description: Here are the questions Evoque owners and garages ask most about the 204DTD engine. Need more help? Speak to our team directly.

faqs.q: Will a replacement 204DTD engine fit my Range Rover Evoque?
faqs.a: We confirm fitment using your VIN and the engine code before supply. We also check the model year, gearbox and drive layout, because ancillaries and calibration can vary between Ingenium engines that look alike.

faqs.q: Is a used, reconditioned or rebuilt engine best for me?
faqs.a: It depends on your budget, mileage and plans for the car. Used engines cost least, reconditioned engines come with new wear parts, and a rebuild keeps your original engine. We advise after inspecting the vehicle.

faqs.q: Do you sell 204DTD engines supply only for trade fitting?
faqs.a: Yes. Independent garages and private buyers can purchase supply only and arrange their own fitting. If you prefer, we can supply and fit the engine at our Grays workshop instead.

faqs.q: How much is a Range Rover Evoque 204DTD engine replacement?
faqs.a: Cost depends on the engine option, the condition of the failed unit, any ancillary parts needed and whether fitting is included. Share your registration or VIN and we will prepare a written quotation for your vehicle.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 204DTD engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover varies with the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. The exact terms are set out in writing with your quote, so you understand the cover before agreeing to any work.

faqs.q: Can you deliver an engine or collect my vehicle?
faqs.a: We deliver engines throughout the UK from Grays, Essex. Delivery details and charges are confirmed in your quote, and customers choosing supply and fit can bring their Evoque to our workshop for installation.

faqs.q: How long will my 204DTD engine replacement take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional repairs found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe when quoting and keep you updated until the vehicle is ready.

workshopIntro.title: Choosing Between Repair, Rebuild and Replacement
workshopIntro.description: Start with the extent of the damage. If a fault is caught early, such as a worn timing chain or a failing turbo, a targeted repair may be enough. When the engine has suffered bearing damage or severe internal wear, a rebuild or Range Rover Evoque 204DTD engine replacement usually makes better long-term sense.
paragraphs: A new engine can be damaged by faults left elsewhere. Where appropriate, we inspect the turbocharger, intercooler and hoses, DPF, EGR components and cooling system, and fit fresh oil, filters and coolant, so debris or contamination from the failed engine is not carried over.

Send us your registration or VIN along with the symptoms you have noticed. We will check compatibility, outline your choices and quote for supply only, supply and fit in Grays, or delivery anywhere in the UK.
